business_context: Car-rental return inspections: visible vehicle damage screening to decide whether further inspection is needed.
operational_ground_truth_policy: For future operational costing, do not invent a condition label for empty-label images. Report their count and separate unknown ground truth from evaluable labelled cases; retain every image in the original detection test split.
limitations: Three confirmed related train-validation pairs; leave supplied splits unchanged and acknowledge possible validation optimism.
One validation and one test photo contain vehicles but have empty labels; do not relabel.
Photo backgrounds, views and image quality differ between classes and may differ from rental inspection photos.
A photo does not establish an accident, its timing, fault, hidden mechanical damage or roadworthiness.
No matches in a pHash screen do not prove full source independence.
